The set of all finite (resp. infinite) words is denoted by Σ∗ (resp. Σω ). A language is a set of words. 2.1 Labelled transition systems A labelled transition system (LTS) A = (Σ, Q, ι, ∆, α) consists of a potentially infinite alphabet Σ, a potentially infinite state-space Q, an initial state ι ∈ Q, a labelled transition relation ∆ ⊆ Q × Σε × Q, and a set of accepting runs α, where a run ρ is a (finite or σ infinite) sequence of transitions starting in ι and following ∆.
